TITLE: At least six killed, including paramedics, in Israeli strike on civil defense center in southern Lebanon
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-15T21:26Z (updated Saturday morning 04:48Z)
AUTHOR: Menna Alaa El-Din (Reuters Cairo)

CAIRO, May 16 (Reuters) — At least six people were killed, including three paramedics, and 22 were wounded in an Israeli strike on a civil defense center in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese state news agency said early Saturday.
